record.name: Cloudflare
record.one_liner: Cloudflare public REST API for developer, infrastructure, and data platforms, using API tokens/keys for authentication.

auth.notes: Cloudflare API supports API tokens (Bearer token) and API Email + Global API Key (X-Auth-Email and X-Auth-Key headers).

access.notes: Developers can sign up for a Cloudflare account and create API tokens directly in the dashboard.

api_surface.notes: Supports a comprehensive REST API with official TypeScript, Python, Go libraries and a Terraform provider.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve account creation, well-documented API tokens, and extensive REST documentation make the Cloudflare API easy to integrate.

evidence.claim: Shows SDKs for TypeScript, Python, Go, and Terraform, plus registrar and general API reference information.
Explains how to create an API token and test it using the /user/tokens/verify endpoint with Bearer authentication.
Demonstrates a REST endpoint using Authorization: Bearer <API_TOKEN>.
Demonstrates legacy API Email + API Key authentication headers (X-Auth-Email and X-Auth-Key).
